result.title: SPGSR: A Small Pixel-Space Generator for One-Step Super-Resolution
result.summary: In one-step super-resolution (SR), vision-only models extract semantic cues directly from the low-resolution (LR) image, keeping those cues spatially aligned with the structures they help restore. Recent models achieve high restoration quality with generators of up to 1.4 billion parameters. Given how much structure the LR image already provides, could a much smaller generator achieve comparable quality? We introduce SPGSR, a vision-only framework that adds a learned RGB correction to the LR image. A frozen DINOv2 guides prediction, and a lightweight block refines the correction locally. SPGSR achieves higher PSNR/SSIM and lower LPIPS/DISTS than VOSR, a leading vision-only SR method, across three benchmarks. Its $31.8\mathrm{M}$-parameter generator is just $6.5\%$ the size of VOSR-0.5B's. SPGSR also achieves competitive quality against T2I-based SR methods. SPGSR's generator uses only $0.60\%$ of the HR pixels used to train and distill VOSR's generator. For $512\times512$ outputs, SPGSR achieves $2.80\times$ and $3.35\times$ GPU-pipeline speedups over VOSR-0.5B and VOSR-1.4B, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPGSR：仅视觉的单步超分框架，用冻结 DINOv2 引导、轻量模块在像素空间学习对 LR 图像的 RGB 修正，以约 31.8M 参数达到与大规模生成器相当的复原质量与更高速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图像复原/生成方向的效率与质量优化，未涉及多模态推理中的状态表示、证据使用或停止决策，也未给出可迁移的 latent 推理线索，故排除。
